current_evidence: The council's 'Submit a planning application' page links this file as 'SCC Local Validation List July 2025' and offers no newer or draft list. The document is headed 'Suffolk County Council Local Validation List 2025'.

issues.detail: The list applies only to minerals, waste and County Council (Regulation 3) development. Grokbot nevertheless put every requirement under 'Full planning' (all flagged INFERRED) and marked 'Minerals & waste (county)' and 'County own devt (Reg 3)' as '(none) - national requirements only'. This is the reverse of the truth: all the local requirements belong under those two types.
issues.evidence: SCC 'is the local planning authority for minerals and waste development and for development carried out by the County Council'. The list 'applies only to these developments'.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured about 10 of the list's 42 items. Missing general requirements: Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment (within the consultation area of a civil/military aerodrome or airstrip); Air Quality Assessment (significant air pollution, or in or near an AQMA); Contaminated Land Assessment (contamination known or suspected by the district council or EA); Dust Assessment (significant dust during demolition, construction or operation); Archaeological Assessment (known or potential archaeological interest or near Suffolk HER sites); Energy Statement (1,000m2+ GIA or site over 1ha); Flood Risk Assessment (site over 1ha in FZ1, 1,000sqm+ new floorspace, FZ2/3, or within or adjacent to a floodplain or main river); Health Impact Assessment; Heritage Assessment (may affect a heritage asset or its setting); Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment; Lighting Assessment (development includes lighting); Noise Assessment; Transport Statement (local-level impact); Travel Plan (County Council applications generating significant traffic or pedestrian movement); Statement of Community Involvement (all applications); Climate Change Statement (all applications); Site Location Plan; Block Plan, Floor plans, Elevations, Roof plan, Site sections and Hard Landscaping Plan (where built infrastructure is constructed, altered or extended); Utilities, fire hydrant and foul sewage connection plan.
issues.evidence: Climate Change Statement: 'All minerals, waste and County Council development planning applications.'

issues.detail: The minerals- and waste-specific requirements are missing: Aftercare Plan (minerals extraction or temporary waste facility that disturbs ground); Agricultural Land Assessment (loss of more than 20ha of BMV land); Glint and Glare Assessment (solar at minerals or waste sites, County Council solar, or next to strategic or local highways); Habitat Monitoring and Management Plan and Soft Landscaping Plan (where BNG applies and is not exempt); Hydrology/Hydrogeology Assessment (ground disturbance above a groundwater protection zone or affecting the water table); Odour Assessment (any waste application, or County Council development with significant odour potential); Phasing Plan (minerals extraction or waste landfill); Planning Statement (minerals) and Planning Statement (waste) (full, variation of condition and NMA applications); Meteorological Site Impact Assessment (structures over 91.4m within the Old Buckenham consultation area; only present as a garbled tab_items fragment).
issues.evidence: Meteorological Site Impact Assessment: 'Any building, structure or works exceeding 91.4m in height above ground level' within the Old Buckenham consultation area.

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is not a requirement in this list. Its trigger is the arboricultural sentence 'If an impact is identified, an Arboricultural Method statement will be required.', copied from the tree row. The list contains no listed-building schedule of works item.
issues.evidence: The list mentions listed building consent only in the Planning Statement (all developments) entry and the DAS note. There is no schedule of works requirement.

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are taken from other entries or give the consequence instead of the trigger. Arboricultural ('If an impact is identified...') should be trees or hedgerows lost or potentially affected, or a TPO within the site boundary. Daylight/Sunlight ('maximising daylight and passive solar gain through the orientation of buildings', which is climate or energy text) should be potential to adversely affect light to neighbouring properties, gardens or amenity space. Drainage/SuDS (climate text about green roofs and rainwater harvesting) should be major development, 1,000sqm+ new floorspace or a site of 1ha or more. Transport Assessment ('What is required? i) A Transport Assessment*') should be 'where the traffic or person(s) trip is significant in both volume and area of impact'.
issues.evidence: Arboricultural Impact Assessment, mandatory where 'trees or hedgerows are proposed to be lost or have the potential to be affected by the development'.

issues.detail: The 'Planning Statement' trigger is an empty numbered fragment ('In addition to that required under 'Planning Statement (all developments)': i. ii. iii. iv...'). The source says Planning Statement (all developments) is mandatory for Full applications, Variation of Conditions, Listed Building Consent and Non-Material Amendments, with additional minerals and waste versions.
issues.evidence: Planning Statement (all developments): 'Full Planning Applications, Variation of Conditions, Listed Building Consent and Non-Material Amendments.'

issues.detail: Listed building consent, Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment are all '(none)', but the Planning Statement (all developments) is mandatory for each. The minerals and waste planning statements also apply to variations and NMAs.
issues.evidence: Planning Statement (all developments): 'Full Planning Applications, Variation of Conditions, Listed Building Consent and Non-Material Amendments.'

issues.detail: The 'Ecological Survey / Assessment (incl. PEA)' row reuses the Shadow Habitats Regulation Assessment trigger (European protected species or a Natura 2000 site). The list's Preliminary Ecological Appraisal is triggered by any potential impact on ecology or biodiversity.
issues.evidence: Preliminary Ecological Appraisal: required where there is potential impact on ecology or biodiversity. Shadow HRA: European protected species or a Natura 2000 site.

issues.detail: 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' with trigger 'public highway, visibility splays, landscaping).' is a fragment of the block plan or site plan content description, not a separate requirement. The Old Buckenham tab_item is filed under 'Submission rules' with a broken URL ('vuk/pdf/...') and is cut off at 'What is required? i.'. It is really the Meteorological Site Impact Assessment requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Any building, structure or works exceeding 91.4m ... Old Buckenham Meteorological radio facility: vuk/pdf/services/... What is required? i.'

issues.detail: The submission page says applicants must also provide the information in the 'Development Management Charter 2022'. Grokbot read the page but did not record this companion document. It was not checked in this audit.
issues.evidence: Submit a planning application page links 'Development Management Charter 2022' (https://www.suffolk.gov.uk/asset-library/2022.developmentmanagementcharter.pdf).

summary: The link is the current July 2025 county list, and the date is right. The extraction is poor, though: about 10 of 42 items were captured, every item is placed under Full planning while the minerals/waste and Reg 3 types (the only ones the list covers) show '(none)', and several triggers are copied from other entries.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
